summary: Focused implementing-agent review of revision17. All 30 packaged files match source. Inline Epic Status checks membership, shared revision, active picklist and fresh remote status; writes only Health__c, verifies it, preserves comments/drafts and clears obsolete Review Status. Existing Watch Path-to-Green requirement enforced before change. Distinct status palette does not alter healthy/attention filters. Three focused Node tests and one combined isolated browser flow passed. This is not an independent review.
caveats: Production GUS write permissions depend on the signed-in user and were not verified through a hosted browser.
If host REST is unavailable, status writes use a pre-save recheck and post-save verification rather than atomic conditional writes.
Missing Health metadata uses the known status choices; Salesforce remains authoritative and rejects invalid values.
No broad suite or live data mutation was performed in tests. Existing AI evidence, sharing and connector limitations remain.
